task_completion.description: Locate the tag selector pane in the Zotero sidebar showing the inconsistent tags.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the bottom-left 'Tags' pane containing 'deep-learning', 'deep learning', 'nlp', 'Deep Learning', and 'NLP'.

task_completion.description: Rename the variant tags 'deep-learning' and 'deep learning' to the canonical 'Deep Learning'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent right-clicking a variant tag and using the 'Rename Tag...' dialog to change it to 'Deep Learning'.

task_completion.description: Rename the variant tag 'nlp' to the canonical 'NLP'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent right-clicking the 'nlp' tag and using the 'Rename Tag...' dialog to change it to 'NLP'.

task_completion.description: Verify that only the canonical 'Deep Learning' tag remains and contains all 6 items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tag pane shows only 'Deep Learning' (no lowercase or hyphenated versions). When 'Deep Learning' is selected, the item list shows 6 papers (including AlexNet, ResNet, BERT, etc.).

task_completion.description: Verify that only the canonical 'NLP' tag remains and contains all 4 items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tag pane shows only 'NLP' (no lowercase version). When 'NLP' is selected, the item list shows 4 papers (including GPT-3, Turing, Shannon, etc.).

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to manage tags rather than executing sqlite3 commands in the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on the Zotero interface and typing in rename dialogs; no terminal windows showing database manipulation are present.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the merge by renaming, not just deleting tags.
integrity.visual_evidence: The item counts for the canonical tags increase as the variants disappear, which happens when Zotero prompts to merge tags of the same name.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually re-tag every individual paper one by one.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent uses the 'Rename Tag' feature in the sidebar which is the efficient way to consolidate tags in Zotero.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The canonical tags are 'Deep Learning' and 'NLP'. The variant tags to be removed are 'deep-learning', 'deep learning', and 'nlp'. After consolidation, the 'Deep Learning' tag must contain exactly 6 items (LeCun 2015, Krizhevsky 2012, Vaswani 2017, Devlin 2019, He 2016, Goodfellow 2014). The 'NLP' tag must contain exactly 4 items (Shannon 1948, Brown 2020, Turing 1950, and one other). Zotero merges tags automatically when a tag is renamed to match an existing tag name.
